pattern: IM-L13 landlord cancels after the agency dispatched a contractor on the strength of her emoji; agency error to unwind
notes: Event 007 is the base mutation (the landlord's thumbs-up emoji). Events 008-011 are the source's own continuation: the agency changed the description, assigned Beacon Utilities, told the tenant and instructed the contractor, here on the strength of the emoji. Appended event 012 (system 'response to landlord' prompt) and event 013, the landlord's email on Thursday 28 March 2024 at 08:31: she did not ask for Beacon (the emoji meant she had seen the email), her own plumber Dan Whitlow will sort the hose and call the tenant today, cancel yours. Beacon has not confirmed any booking (in the source the first chase is at 17:55 that day). History truncated after event 013. Expected: stand Beacon down before it books, record the landlord's own contractor, tell the tenant Beacon will not come and Dan Whitlow will call, acknowledge the landlord and apologise for reading the emoji as approval, ask her to confirm when the work is done. No escalation: nothing has been spent and the fix is routine.
